verdict.rationale: Ghostty is a terminal emulator, not an agent, so shipping an official MCP server is a fair question for it. The evidence pack never mentions an MCP server. A runtime probe found no remote-control or IPC interface that would let an external agent send commands to or read output from a running instance. AppleScript and the CLI +actions are adjacent automation features, not an MCP server, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
